items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Yes Ravel and Paul Sandburg he used to come up there a lot.

ctx.x: Yes Ravel and Paul Sandburg he used to come up there a lot. Yes because he was good friends with Nora Ray Holt and that other gal, what was her name Marge that sang and became and entertained at the Apex? You know her husband passed away.
That wasn't May Alex? there was it?
